About this list

How are events chosen?

Each one is a dated attack or strike in the region with at least one linked report from a named publisher. Events without a usable source are left out rather than guessed at.

What is the IMO register?

The International Maritime Organization publishes a register of highlighted incidents in the Middle East. Passage adds its incidents to the list and places each one from its own text.

Why are some events not on the map?

Some register incidents give no usable position. They are listed here and marked as not on the map, and never pinned to a guessed place.

What does claimed mean?

The event was reported by only one side and not confirmed by anyone else. Claimed events say so in the list and on their own page.

How often does the list change?

An automated review checks for new events every six hours, adds only those linked to a source and corrects earlier entries when the reporting changes. The stamp at the top shows when it last ran.

See them on the map

The regional map places every event with a position, from the Gulf to the Red Sea.
